messages:
Leah Kim: Heads-up — demo webinar next Tue 11am PT. Need reg page live, Zoom ops set, and post-event lead flow. Who picks what?
Diego Alvarez: I can do the reg page. Plan: single-field email + optional company, hidden utm params, GDPR checkbox, and CTA to request clips. Need hero graphic and one-liner.
Priya Singh: Posting copy in 15m. Will include short privacy blurb and transcript opt-in.
Sam Cho: Zoom ops: enable cloud recording (active speaker + shared screen), separate audio track, enable SRT export, add two alternative hosts, and enable auto-assign co-host.
Noah Bennett: Ill own caption QA and transcript handoff. Otter integration OK. Ill upload SRT + plain transcript to Drive and tag clip owners.
Tom Ruiz: HubSpot routing: form submit -> create contact, set original_source={{utm_source}}, add to list "Webinar-Demo-Regs", send immediate confirmation. Post-event: attended -> tag "attended" + send replay @24h; no-shows -> nurture @48h with 3 clips.
Diego Alvarez: Quick question: two-step verify email or single? For trial audience, keep single-step to reduce friction.
Leah Kim: Agreed, single-step. Add calendar .ics on confirmation page.
Sam Cho: Contingency plan: if cloud recording fails, switch to local host recording + RTMP backup. Ill bring spare laptop and start local recording at runthrough.
ops-bot: Event created: "Demo: Production Inference" Tue 11:00am PT. Zoom link added.
Leah Kim: Action items recap: Diego = reg page + test, Priya = copy + confirmation email, Sam = Zoom config + runthrough, Noah = captions + SRT handoff, Tom = HubSpot workflow. Check-in tomorrow 10am PT. :thumbsup:
